tokens.name: stage
tokens.usage: Behind the video itself: letterbox and pillarbox bars, the full-screen player backdrop. Never a page background; pages use surface.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: App background for Library, Search and Settings. Also the text colour on citron and alert fills, via on-citron.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, bottom sheets, menus, notices, the server status pill, and the placeholder behind a thumbnail that is still loading.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and list separators on surface and surface-raised, and the unplayed part of the scrubber track. Too faint (1.4:1) for a control border or anything that carries meaning; use ink-muted for those.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface, surface-raised, stage and scrim (17:1 on surface; 5.2:1 on scrim over a pure-white frame).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: durations, file sizes, codecs, captions, folder counts, unselected tabs; also the buffered part of the scrubber and the border of outlined controls (3:1+). Reads on surface (7.0:1), surface-raised (6.3:1) and stage. Not on scrim: over a bright frame it drops below 3:1, so secondary text in the player uses ink.

tokens.name: citron
tokens.usage: Riffle's one accent: the played part of the scrubber, the scrubber thumb, the primary Play button, selected tab, focus ring and links. As text, on surface or surface-raised (15:1). Use it sparingly: one citron thing per view outside the scrubber.

tokens.name: on-citron
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a citron fill (the Play glyph, a primary button label) and on an alert fill. An alias of surface.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Laid over the video while player controls are showing, so ink and citron controls read on any frame (ink holds 5.2:1, citron 4.6:1 even over pure white).

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Errors only: a file the server couldn't read, a video that won't load, failed previews, an offline server. Always with a word or icon beside it. As text, on surface or surface-raised (6.7:1); as a fill, label it in on-citron.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "SF Pro Display", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen: the large navigation title (Library, Search, Settings).

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section headers on a scrolling screen, and the video title on the detail page.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Video titles on cards and rows, sheet titles, button labels.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Pick up where you left off on any device.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata under a title, in ink-muted: folder, duration, file size, codec. In the player, over scrim, in ink.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Short uppercase badges on thumbnails, rows and in the player: 4K, HDR, HEVC, 5.1, CC. Never a sentence.

styles.name: tab
styles.usage: Tab bar labels only, under a 26 pt icon. Matches the iOS tab bar.

styles.name: timecode
styles.usage: Elapsed and remaining time beside the scrubber, and the duration chip on thumbnails. Monospaced so digits don't jitter while playing.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside badges and between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a title and its caption, between thumbnails in a dense grid, and the scrubber's hit-area padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side margins, card padding, gap between rows in a list.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections on a scrolling screen, and around the transport controls in the player.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, duration chips, small thumbnails in lists.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, video thumbnails and cards, bottom sheets, notices and the scrub preview frame. The video itself is never rounded in full screen.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The Play button and other round transport controls, the scrubber track and thumb, segmented controls and chips.
